facts.text: Serve the cocoa when Scott takes Carol on their first date.
facts.why: Scott and Carol have cocoa and a blanket on the horse-drawn sleigh ride to the faculty party, but it follows a few failed dates, so it is not their first.
facts.fix: Serve the cocoa when Scott takes Carol on the sleigh ride.

facts.text: Believe in Santa? Fine, Scott, but you're carving the roast first.
facts.why: Carol never says this. She does not know Scott is Santa until Charlie shows her the snow globe near the end, and she throws Scott out when he first tries to tell her. A real short line nearby is Charlie's to Carol.
facts.fix: Seeing isn't believing, believing is seeing.

fix_note.text: Seeing isn't believing, believing is seeing.

facts.why: Curtis is the head elf who keeps the Handbook of Christmas. Toy Santa is the animatronic double that Curtis helps Scott build. Curtis is not the double.
facts.fix: Curtis and his toy Santa double

facts.why: Same mix up. Curtis, the Keeper of the Handbook, helps build the Toy Santa double. He is not the double.
facts.fix: Curtis and his toy Santa double

facts.text: Raised at the Mrs. Claus wedding.
facts.why: Scott marries Carol at the end, so a toast at the wedding is fair. Menu joke.

vibe.verdict: A proper North Pole banquet with the Mrs Claus Clause, Easter Bunny offspring and tinsel football, but the cocoa buzz cue does not print on either face.
ideas: Rename 'Elf-made peppermint hot cocoa' to 'Abby's designer bean cocoa' and add a 'Toy Santa feels a little buzz' note
Swap 'Sparkling apple and ginger' for a drink called 'The Molinator' with a Tooth Fairy note
Replace the Mother Nature maple vegetables note with the Easter Bunny's 33,000 offspring joke
Change the place card to the de-Santafication countdown, '28 days, find a wife by Christmas Eve'
changed: Cue now Toy Santa's little buzz
Cocoa renamed for Abby's designer beans
Vegetable note now the Easter Bunny's 33,000 offspring
